title: Deck the Halls with the Return of Dutch Bros® Jingle Nog
summary: Jingle Nog is back at Dutch Bros! Enjoy rich holiday eggnog in the Jingle Nog Latte or Chai, served hot or iced with Soft Top®. Available while supplies last.
body_markdown:
## Deck the Halls with the Return of Dutch Bros® Jingle Nog


Holiday magic is back in the drive-thru! 🎁 Whether you’re out seeing festive lights or running last-minute errands, the Dutch Bros holiday lineup just got a major seasonal upgrade. The fan-fave Jingle Nog is making its grand return for a limited time at all Dutch Bros locations, while supplies last!


[Jingle Nog Latte ❤️](https://www.dutchbros.com/menu/seasonal-drinks/)


This fave delivers warmth, spice and seasonal magic in every sip. Handcrafted with espresso and rich holiday eggnog all topped off with Soft Top® and colorful holly sprinks. Customize this one by ordering it Hot or Iced!


[Jingle Nog Chai 💚](https://www.dutchbros.com/menu/seasonal-drinks/) ****


Your new holiday staple has arrived! This sip is made with chai and delicious holiday eggnog, complete with Soft Top® and festive holly sprinks. Best enjoyed Hot or Iced!


Find the nearest Dutch Bros on our[location page](https://www.dutchbros.com/locations) or the[DB app](https://www.dutchbros.com/rewards) !
